name: country_name comment: 国家名称（英文） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_name_local comment: 本地语言名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dial_code comment: 电话区号（如+1/+33） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: default_currency_code comment: 法定货币 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: default_language_code comment: 主要语言 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency comment: 货币 note: ISO 4217 作主键，decimal_places 影响价格计算（JPY=0, USD=2, KWD=3） columns: - name: currency_code comment: 货币代码（如USD/EUR/GBP） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_name comment: 货币名称（英文） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_symbol comment: 符号（如$/€/£） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: decimal_places comment: 小数位数 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: language comment: 语言 note: IETF BCP 47 作主键（如en-US/es-US/fr-FR），区分地区差异 columns: - name: language_code comment: 语言代码（如en-US/fr-FR） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: language_name comment: 语言名称（英文） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: native_name comment: 本地名称（如Español） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: text_direction comment: 文字方向（ltr/rtl） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market comment: 市场 note: 一个Market可含多个国家，Channel归属Market columns: - name: market_id comment: 市场ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_code comment: 市场编码（如US/EU/LATAM） constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_name comment: 市场名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: default_currency_code comment: 默认货币 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: default_language_code comment: 默认语言 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: timezone comment: 主时区 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态（活跃/停用） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_country comment: 市场-国家映射 note: country_code UNIQUE：一个国家只能归属一个Market columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_id comment: 市场 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY, UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_language comment: 市场-语言映射 note: fallback_language_code：翻译缺失时回退语言 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_id comment: 市场 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: language_code comment: 语言代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_default comment: 是否默认语言 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fallback_language_code comment: 回退语言 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_currency comment: 市场-货币映射 note: exchange_rate：相对基准货币的汇率 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_id comment: 市场 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_code comment: 货币代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_default comment: 是否默认货币 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: exchange_rate comment: 汇率 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rate_updated_at comment: 汇率更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rounding_rule comment: 价格取整规则（none/up/down/nearest） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_domain comment: 市场域名配置 note: 支持多种域名策略：主域名/子路径/子域名/国家域名 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: market_id comment: 市场 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: domain_type comment: 域名类型（primary/subfolder/subdomain/ccTLD） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: domain_value comment: 域名值 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: language_code comment: 对应语言 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_default comment: 是否默认域名 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: translation comment: 内容翻译 note: 集中式EAV模式：统一翻译工作流 + 语言回退逻辑只写一次 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: entity_type comment: 实体类型（如spu/brand/category） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: entity_id comment: 实体ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_name comment: 字段名（如name/description） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: language_code comment: 目标语言 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: content comment: 翻译内容 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source comment: 翻译来源（人工/机器/第三方） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态（草稿/已发布） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: country to: currency type: N:1 label: 法定货币 color: '#4A90D9' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: language type: N:1 label: 主要语言 color: '#4A90D9' penwidth: 1.4 - from: market to: currency type: N:1 label: 默认货币 color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: market to: language type: N:1 label: 默认语言 color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: market_country to: market type: N:1 label: 归属市场 color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: market_country to: country type: N:1 label: 国家 color: '#E8833A' - from: market_language to: market type: N:1 label: 市场 color: '#E8833A' - from: market_language to: language type: N:1 label: 语言 color: '#E8833A' - from: market_language to: language type: N:1 label: 回退语言 color: '#90A4AE' style: dashed - from: market_currency to: market type: N:1 label: 市场 color: '#E8833A' - from: market_currency to: currency type: N:1 label: 货币 color: '#E8833A' - from: market_domain to: market type: N:1 label: 市场 color: '#E8833A' - from: market_domain to: language type: N:1 label: 对应语言 color: '#90A4AE' style: dashed - from: translation to: language type: N:1 label: 目标语言 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 design_rules: market_definition: Market = 销售区域配置单元，一个Market可包含多个国家（如欧盟市场），也可只含一个国家（如美国市场）。Channel归属Market，是Market的下层维度 country_unique_rule: market_country.country_code 加 UNIQUE 约束，确保一个国家只能归属一个Market，避免客户被多个Market同时服务 language_fallback: market_language.fallback_language_code 定义翻译缺失时的回退语言（如 es-US 缺失回退到 en-US），避免显示空白 translation_eav: translation 表采用集中式 EAV 模式（entity_type + entity_id + field_name），所有业务域的翻译内容统一存储。优势：统一翻译工作流、语言回退逻辑只写一次、翻译覆盖率一条SQL统计 translation_unique: UNIQUE(entity_type, entity_id, field_name, language_code)，同一实体同一字段同一语言只有一条翻译 currency_exchange: market_currency.exchange_rate 存相对基准货币的汇率，rounding_rule 控制价格取整策略（如 $9.99 vs $10.00） domain_strategy: market_domain 支持四种域名策略：primary（主域名）、subfolder（如/fr）、subdomain（如fr.looply.com）、ccTLD（如looply.fr） reference_data_pk: 基础参考数据（country/currency/language）使用国际标准代码作主键（ISO 3166-1/ISO 4217/BCP 47），语义清晰，跨模块引用时可读性强 cross_module_impact: Market模块引入后，商品域channel表需新增market_id FK，用户表country_code应FK引用country表。所有业务域按多市场设计
